extracted.name: Breakfast Potatoes
extracted.description: These easy Breakfast Potatoes are roasted in the oven resulting in the perfect crispy on the outside, soft in the middle, potatoes.
ingredient_lines: 2.5 pounds red potatoes (, cut into bite-size chunks)
instruction_lines: In a large bowl toss together the potatoes, garlic, onion, green bell pepper, red bell pepper, olive oil, butter, seasoned salt, cayenne pepper and salt and pepper.
Bake: Pour potatoes onto a rimmed baking sheet. Bake for 15-20 minutes, tossing twice during baking.
Increase oven temp to 500 degrees (or broil) until crispy, about 10-15 more minutes, tossing twice.
